text:
Ava: Heads-up — I'm kicking off a quick pulse on API v2 compat for the billing depgraph. Need owners + blockers before tomorrow's canary.
Ben: Ack. I'm owner for billing-service -> will check header propagation tests.
Jules: I can cover SDK surface (python, ts). Noticed a breaking change in the OpenAPI shape in #4578.
Kai: infra note — proxy will still accept v1 but we'll return a deprecation header when routed to legacy.
Lina: depgraph preview: https://rwd.link/depgraph/billing-v2 — pointing downstream owners, please scan.
Ben: quick status — unit tests green, e2e failing on auth header (investigating)
Jules: PR for SDK shim: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/789 — adds header alias and opt-in flag. Needs @Ben review.
Ava: can we toggle a feature flag for canary? Propose slice=10% tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary 'v2-compat-canary' at 2025-11-12T14:00:00Z (id: canary-20251112)
Kai: added nginx route rule and fallback, will monitor latency and error budget. Also pushed a small kernel tweak to keep KV-cache warm.
Ben: debugging auth issue — root cause is header name case mismatch in kotlin client. Will push fix by EOD.
Jules: SDK will ship 0.21.1 with compat shim. Docs PR coming shortly.
Lina: FYI compliance needs audit logs on deprecation header — ticket INF-332 created.
Ava: OK owners: Ben (billing), Jules (SDK), Kai (infra), Lina (depgraph/audit). Please tick items on the checklist: unit/e2e, shim PR, canary flag, telemetry.
Ava: Quick checklist: 1) unit/e2e green, 2) shim PR merged, 3) canary flagged, 4) telemetry alerts added.
Ben: unit green, e2e flaky — will post update in 30m.
Jules: shim ready, needs one more review.
Kai: infra done, perf +2% p50, no regressions so far.
deploy-bot: canary started (canary-20251112) — routing 10% to v2.
Ben: e2e passed on canary slice, auth fix validated.
Jules: merging SDK PR now.
Ava: Thanks — if no blockers by 17:00 UTC we'll roll to 100% tomorrow.
Lina: added audit entry and retention tag.
Ben: :thumbsup:
Jules: :shipit:
Ava: Closing loop — leave any post-mortem notes here.
